tldr: Anthropic put Claude Desktop into beta on three inference backends at once on June 22 — AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Foundry — covering chat, Cowork, and Claude Code. Microsoft Foundry was the least mature of the three from the start, without the data-residency guarantees Anthropic already documents for Bedrock and Vertex AI.
whats_new: Claude reached general availability on Microsoft Foundry with Azure-native billing and governance on July 5, but there's still no European data zone, so European banks and healthcare practitioners say the offering is unapproved for production use.
why_it_matters: Foundry is now the odd backend out: Anthropic's own documentation confirms data-residency guarantees for Bedrock and Vertex AI but not Foundry, so GA didn't close that regulatory gap — it just made the missing guarantee more visible to teams evaluating it for EU workloads.

status.reenable: no announced timeline for an EU data zone on Foundry
status.detail: Claude is GA on Microsoft Foundry with Azure billing and governance, but the absence of a European data zone leaves regulated EU deployments blocked.

beats.headline: Claude Desktop goes into beta on AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Foundry
beats.summary: Chat, Claude Cowork, and Claude Code all become available for inference on Microsoft Foundry alongside the two established clouds.

beats.headline: Foundry reaches GA, but no EU data zone blocks regulated deployments
beats.summary: Azure-native billing and governance ship, yet Anthropic's data-residency guarantees still cover only Bedrock and Vertex AI — European banking and healthcare teams call the Foundry offering unapproved for production.

open_questions: Will Anthropic add a European data zone for Microsoft Foundry to match the residency guarantees already offered on Bedrock and Vertex AI?
Do other regulated markets outside Europe face the same production-approval gap on Foundry?
take_for_builders: If you're deploying Claude through Microsoft Foundry for EU-regulated workloads, don't assume data-residency parity with Bedrock or Vertex AI — check Anthropic's current residency documentation before greenlighting a production deployment there.
